title: Stability of a Korteweg--de Vries equation close to critical lengths
summary: In this paper, we investigate the quantitative exponential stability of the Korteweg-de Vries equation on a finite interval with its length close to the critical set. Sharp decay estimates are obtained via a constructive PDE control framework. We first introduce a novel transition-stabilization approach, combining the Lebeau--Robbiano strategy with the moment method, to establish constructive null controllability for the KdV equation.
